Too bad, they are all frozen. They also all have stagnation, hope you have Saya wheel to help you out with that. Oh no, the enemy is about to hit you for 1,5k damage, but don't shield - or they'll reduce your max hp! Surely you pulled for the latest shill character who makes mob waves trivial in snow terrain and also gives you max hp? And all this endless talk about creativity and teambuilding while undermining player agency and choice with every design step. author: @ICE.AMERICANO
text:
My positive feelings toward B.I.V.A have been completely shattered.
I’m not spending any more money on this game.
I really wanted them to succeed, so I didn't hesitate at all to spend money. But the way things are being run now makes me too uneasy to keep spending; I’ve even started to feel like the money I’ve already spent was a waste.
I was one of those who firmly believed they would become the next Project Moon. But I guess I overestimated their abilities.
It seems there was a reason why this game nearly shut down in the past.
This game is no longer safe; the situation is so dire that it wouldn't be surprising if the service shut down at any moment. I can't trust them anymore.
I am by no means the only one who thinks this; at least 70% of the people in the community I’m active in share the same view.
It is the truth, without a single lie.
